## Read 3, DiT half (the registered read needs both beds and ≥ 0.3 dB on PixArt; PixArt not run)

- Feedback vs single table: -17.4% [-20.0, -15.1]. Needs ≥ 10% with CI > 0 → **met** on DiT.
- Feedback vs each stateless arm run: sym2 -6.9% [-8.4, -5.3]; unif -5.2% [-6.2, -4.1] → **beats every stateless arm run**.
- Stateless arms that clear the ≥ 10% bar on DiT: sym2 -11.3% [-13.5, -9.3], unif -12.9% [-15.5, -10.6]. Best stateless arm: **unif**. Feedback adds -5.2% [-6.2, -4.1] over it. The 'stateless is the construction' clause needs feedback to add < 5%: point estimate ≥ 5% → that clause **does not hold** (the CI's lower bound is below 5%, so this is narrow).
- Arm 4 (4-phase cycling, both orders) was **not run** (budget ceiling), so 'beats arms 2–4' is evaluated on arms 2–3 only.
- **Outcome label for feedback:** cancellation **constructed and survived downstream**. The rounding part is bounded at the sites (identity closes to ≤ 1e-7; ‖s_last‖ ≤ Δ/2, ‖Ση‖ ≈ 0.02, ‖Σd‖ ≤ 0.09 on the checked layers). Prediction C/I falls 0.133 → 0.034, and the endpoint falls -17.4% [-20.0, -15.1]. The cumulative site error that remains is the baseline's own input-clip error Σc (identical in both arms, step-constant, never fed back by design). None of the three failure labels (not constructed / lost to representation / lost downstream) applies.
- The per-step reference is *worse* than the single table on this bed (prediction C/I doubles). B′'s '≥ 50% of the per-step gain' criterion has no gain to recover: reported, not applied.
